truth: Every observation has two binary sites per role A, B and C. In every replicate one hidden site per role is chosen uniformly. Other sites are independent Bernoulli(q). Hidden A starts Bernoulli(q). Hidden B copies hidden A with probability s, otherwise Bernoulli(q). Hidden C equals hidden A xor B with probability k, otherwise Bernoulli(q). (s,k) are the registered law parameters. Wrong-partner observations independently replace their entire C component with an independent donor from exactly its population marginal; in particular hidden P(C=1)=(1-k)q+k(1-s)2q(1-q). Missingness is iid per individual site after substitution. The copy mechanism induces one true AB dependence when s>0. Only the hidden triple has a nonzero three-factor interaction when k>0. Hidden labels in null conditions are placeholders, never scored as hits.
streams: All grid cells and repetitions run once. NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence entropy comprises root seed, integer cell index in lexicographic nested registration order (depth, frequency, missing, contamination, law in displayed order), repetition, and purpose code (0 hidden target, 1 training cohort, 2 validation cohort, 3 outer test cohort, 4 uncertainty). The three cohorts are generated independently, conditional on the hidden target. No reruns to replace failures.
training: Exhaustively screen all four AB pairs by empirical complete-case mutual information in bits and all eight ABC triples by native local MaxEnt connected_information_bits, prior total mass 1, tolerance 1e-8, up to 300 IPF iterations. Require >=8 complete rows and both binary states present at every selected site. Highest finite eligible score wins, ties broken by smallest lexicographic coordinate, no access to hidden labels, validation or outer test. Fit pair-only M2 and saturated M3 for the winning triple on training counts with total uniform prior mass in {0.5,8}. Select smoothing separately for each model by best validation mean joint log probability in nats per jointly complete row, first/smaller mass wins ties. Keep the training-only fits; do not refit on validation. No other settings tuned.
testing: On independent outer test rows require >=8 complete cases per selected tuple. No rediscovery or retuning. Compare the winning triple's held-out mean log probability for M3 versus M2, in nats per complete triple observation; report positive-gain incidence and mean gain with a replicate-level interval. Unsmoothed two-sided probability-ordered exact fixed-margin tests evaluate AB independence in the 2x2 table and absence of a three-way loglinear interaction in the 2x2x2 table conditional on all pair margins. Enumerate feasible alternating-sign cell shifts and give each table weight proportional to 1/product(factorial(cell count)), including likelihood ties within 1e-12 log units. A singleton fiber yields p=1. Degenerate margins may yield p=1. Hold-out exact tests do not test the selection or the full joint model's fit. Raw alpha=.05 for each selected hypothesis; also report Benjamini-Hochberg at q=.05 across these two tests, treating unavailable tests as p=1. A wrong coordinate or absent truth is a false discovery. Estimate realized mean per-replicate FDP with zero assigned when nothing is rejected.
reporting: 64 cells x 64 replicates = 4096 planned. Report every cell and all planned repetitions including failed screening/insufficient support/lack of valid fit. Per-target selection and end-to-end correct significant recovery rates use all planned draws for planted laws. Per-test any rejection, wrong rejection, BH-correct discovery, wrong discovery and any-discovery, and positive held-out gains are separate; report both all-draw and evaluable denominators where meaningful. Give successes/denominator and Wilson 95% intervals for binary rates. For fractional FDP and mean log predictive gain use a deterministic nonparametric percentile bootstrap across independent replicates within the same fixed cell (1000 bootstrap samples); return unavailable if fewer than two values. Enumerate mean eligible counts, complete-row counts, fit status/exclusion reasons and smoothing choices. No individual-row/coordinate data required. This is a synthetic binary and iid donor sensitivity, complementing existing latent-clade/F81/blocked-CV studies. Do not present favorable settings alone.
